source: Souviks catalogue product/engineering dimensions and standard-part geometric assumptions
purpose: Estimated net item weights plus single-unit packaging allowances for shipping; not manufacturer measured weights.

profiles.carton_cut_wrap: Estimated 5% per-unit protective wrap/material allowance only. The outer carton tare and measured external carton dimensions are separate parcel-level inputs and are not included.
profiles.plastic_wrap_no_carton: Estimated 5% protective plastic-wrap allowance only; no carton tare is included.

method: Calculate theoretical metal mass from item geometry where a complete or standardised shape is available. Solid shank/prism and standard fastener dimensions are explicit assumptions; estimates remain labelled estimated. For standard fasteners, DIN/ISO reference dimensions or published per-piece masses are used only as explicit assumptions; where the catalogue does not identify the governing standard, confidence is reduced.

standards_assumptions.purpose: Flat steel washer dimensions used where only nominal fastener size is in the catalogue.
Spring lock washer reference dimensions and published per-piece mass.
Metric hex-head bolt across-flats and head-height assumptions.
Standard metric hex nut geometry assumptions; use DIN 934 rather than ISO 4032 because the catalogue does not specify the governing nut standard.

rounding_rule: estimated_item_packed_weight_g = ceil(net_weight_g × 1.05) grams. This excludes carton tare; do not map it to approx_weight_g or use for courier freight until parcel-level packing adds carton mass and external L × W × H.
notes: Universal-joint crosses are excluded: bearing-cap diameter and overall span do not provide sufficient geometry to determine the steel mass of the cross body, cups, rollers and seals.
PVC/PU fittings, belts, rubber parts, lights, cables, filters, brake linings and other non-ferrous/non-solid products must not use the iron-density model.
The 5% per-item packaging allowance is a provisional protective-wrap allowance only; it is not measured carton tare.
These unit estimates are not complete shipping freight weights. Keep catalogue approx_weight_g unset until parcel-level carton/wrap tare and external parcel dimensions are calculated or measured.
